answer: The finality of attestations only counts when the attestator is established, so a fresh cluster of aliases cannot push any transaction to finality until it has spent many epochs proving honesty. Consequently, an attacker with a large flock pays more to keep it alive than it can ever extract, which is why Sybil campaigns fail here.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a quill as the anchor of the cost.
